name: RestRequest
description: Represents a single HTTP request in RestSharp with resource path, method, parameters, body, and per-request timeout.

fields.name: resource
fields.description: Resource path relative to base URL

fields.name: method
fields.description: HTTP method: GET, POST, PUT, DELETE, PATCH, HEAD, OPTIONS

fields.name: parameters
fields.description: Request parameters (path, query, header, body, cookie)

fields.name: requestFormat
fields.description: Body serialization format: Json, Xml, MultipartFormData, UrlEncodedForm
